plans.idea: Centered typographic poster: one wide, tall text block across the canvas so the headline grows big and the subheadline sets on a single line (no orphaned 'next.'), with an evenly balanced yellow field around it and a small minor slot tucked beneath on the same centre axis.

Banner-style left-aligned stack: the text block hugs a strong left edge and spans most of the width so it reads left to right like a cover, leaving deliberate breathing room on the right, with the minor slot anchored bottom-right to balance the weight.

Full-width message band with a footer sign-off: headline and subheadline fill the upper ~80% edge to edge at maximum size, and a thin full-width strip along the bottom carries the brand line like a signature, giving a clear top-to-bottom hierarchy.
